description: Interventions de sécurité de la Direction de la Voirie sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction de la Voirie - Services généraux Patrimoine. Cette couche de points localise les différentes interventions de sécurité opérées par la Direction de la Voirie de Rennes Métropole sur son territoire, depuis janvier 2024. Elle remplace les mains courantes et les fiches d'intervention papier qui étaient précédemment rédigées par les agents après chaque intervention. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are accident, route, sécurité routière, accident de la route. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
